groups.title: Code projects: tests and code checks included
Workspaces: organised folders for creative and client work, no code checks

template:web-golden.title: Website
template:web-golden.line: Static pages only: no login or database (for an app, pick Web app). TypeScript, Vite

template:python-golden.title: Python service or tool
template:python-golden.line: A web server and a command-line tool you can run, not a code library. Python, FastAPI

template:ts-node-golden.title: TypeScript service or tool
template:ts-node-golden.line: A web server and a command-line tool that run on Node.js, with no web pages. TypeScript

template:go-golden.title: Go command-line program
template:go-golden.line: A program you run in a terminal, set up with tests and code checks. Go

template:rust-golden.title: Rust command-line program
template:rust-golden.line: A program you run in a terminal, set up with tests and code checks. Rust

template:dotnet-golden.title: C# command-line program
template:dotnet-golden.line: A program you run in a terminal, set up with tests and code checks. C#, .NET

template:cpp-golden.title: C++ command-line program
template:cpp-golden.line: A program you run in a terminal, set up with tests and code checks. C++, CMake

kit:image-set.title: AI image set
kit:image-set.line: Prompts, references and pictures from first tries to approved finals; not model training. ComfyUI

kit:video-production.title: Film or video made with AI
kit:video-production.line: Reference looks, generated shots, footage, sound and finished cuts. Not a channel.

kit:video-channel.title: YouTube or short video channel
kit:video-channel.line: One folder per episode or short, plus brand, shared music and ideas. Not a single film.

kit:music-production.title: Music or audio production
kit:music-production.line: One folder per song for lyrics, takes, stems, mixes and masters, plus shared samples.

kit:comic-storyboard.title: Comic or storyboard
kit:comic-storyboard.line: Script, character sheets and one folder per page, from rough sketch to lettering.

kit:studio-3d.title: 3D art for many tools
kit:studio-3d.line: Folders for 3D sources and exports across tools; for one Unreal game, pick Unreal game.

kit:game-assets.title: Unreal game with its art
kit:game-assets.line: Folders for an Unreal game and its Blender/Houdini source art; for art only, pick 3D art.

kit:godot-game.title: Game made with Godot
kit:godot-game.line: Folders for game scenes, scripts and art, with source art kept apart. Godot

kit:lora-training.title: Train a custom AI model
kit:lora-training.line: Folders for training data, captions, runs and evaluations; not for making images. LoRA

kit:client-job.title: Client or freelance job
kit:client-job.line: Folders for the brief, contract, working files, review rounds, deliveries and invoices.

kit:research-writing.title: Research paper or long writing
kit:research-writing.line: Folders for sources, reading notes, outlines, section drafts, figures and citations.

kit:web-app.title: Web app with design files
kit:web-app.line: Folders for app code, tests and design files; for plain pages, pick Website.

kit:component-library.title: Library of reusable Python code
kit:component-library.line: Folders for reusable code and tests; for a server or tool, pick Python service. Python

kit:homelab.title: Home servers and network
kit:homelab.line: Notes and settings per machine, network rules, how-to steps and backup records.
